approval_scope: Current four-variant MSVR310 seed42 trial is source-ready for its required CUDA contract and all-four smoke gate. Full50 remains contingent on those actual runtime gates. This is not acceptance of any neural result or of the original all-three-dataset +2pp objective.

resolved_findings.finding: Plan said AdamW while the inherited MSVR310 config selects Adam.
resolved_findings.resolution: Executor corrected only the plan metadata to Adam, preserving the matched existing optimizer.

resolved_findings.finding: The runner exposes RGBNT201 but the first base_supervision version asserted DIRECT=False; RGBNT201 actually sets DIRECT=1.
resolved_findings.resolution: Executor restored the original concatenated-global classifier/bottleneck path for DIRECT=True and adjusted the two loss weight lists. Stdlib calls verify both branches and all pair/weight lengths. AST comparison confirms model construction and all other implementation remain unchanged; MSVR310 weights are identical.

correct_by_source_review.conclusion: The shared head receives mean available raw CLIP CLS512 plus pooled projected patch512. The final 5632D descriptor uses sqrt(.75) normalized private5120 and sqrt(.25) normalized common512, giving common cosine mass .25. Frequency residual is added to the nonzero common identity block before normalization.

correct_by_source_review.topic: Available sources and legal private coordinates
correct_by_source_review.conclusion: All-available encoding calls original DeMo fusion. A missing modality skips its backbone and reduction. For partial batches, ineligible HDM relations are zeroed, their gate logits are masked, and their BN expert modules are not called. Private M/I increments are eligible-only. Batch uniformity and at least one available modality are asserted.

The three augmented variants construct the identical parameter/module set and share seed control; only reading/routing behavior changes. The CUDA gate explicitly compares all augmented initial state keys/tensors and parameter counts, plus all four shared head states. Full fused/base/global/shared losses and M/F auxiliaries have the planned weights; contribution is .05 only for augmented models. DeMo shares the metric interface and partial augmentation. Runtime equality/gradient claims remain untested in this review.

Full loss backward precedes the partial forward. Only the small detached full descriptor gallery survives; output is deleted and retain_graph is not used. The partial view reuses the same augmented tensors, samples one of six proper nonempty sets per batch from its own seeded generator, and adds .25 label-smoothed CE plus .5 normalized soft triplet. Positives use ground-truth equal IDs excluding self; negatives use different IDs. Gallery and contribution targets are stopped. There are two scaled backwards, one unscale, one optimizer step and one scaler update; effective/AMP-skipped updates are logged.

Fit/dev come from installed official training records with held-out identity IDs. Fit identities are relabeled only for training; evaluation retains true IDs. Seed42, B64, existing Adam config, native AMP initial scale512 and fresh50 are explicit. The identity sampler provides same-ID positives and distinct-ID negatives; worker augmentations and batch selection are matched across variants. No official test function is called by this trial.

Strict greater-than dev mAP retains the earliest tied best. Strict model reload is checked before terminal completion. All seven encoded availability banks feed all49 pairs with the same dev IDs, query order and gallery. Same-ID/same-scene exclusion is used for MSVR310, same-ID/same-camera for RGBNT. Clean features must exactly match saved best features and clean distances are reused unchanged. Full mAP/mINP/R1/R5/R10/R20, CMC1..50, per-query rows and camera/scene/identity groups are written. Weights and source input files are checked unchanged during frozen evaluation.

Only best.pth is written as a model weight file. Smoke strict reload uses BytesIO; no initial/last/smoke checkpoint is written by this runner. Existing baseline/pretraining checkpoints are read rather than overwritten.

The sole wave has four fixed GPU slots on2026 and sequential train/frozen work per slot. All four smoke completions are required before any train starts. Nonzero child exits retain logs/exit receipts and propagate; there is no automatic retry or complete marker on failure. Resource waits use240 seconds. The deployment helper checks the existing review/plan/helper/source digests, predecessor source bytes, unused output/source paths, all four idle GPUs, disk space and absence of the existing environment process before staging; source and idle-GPU checks repeat before its one controller launch. Source/mocks establish at most four owned concurrent jobs; actual live hardware/global activity was not queried by this reviewer.

required_before_full50: all four actual smoke jobs have3 real updates, finite nonzero gradients, and strict in-memory reload equality
